comment: External trust anchor for the AttestArc knowledge plane. This file ships INSIDE the SSH-signed skill release and is the one root of trust that lives OUTSIDE any downloaded knowledge bundle. A downloaded artifact is trusted ONLY when its Sigstore build-provenance attestation matches the identity pinned here (repo + signer_workflow + oidc_issuer + git ref). The SAN check is artifact-SPECIFIC: a knowledge bundle (manifest/archive) is verified against cert_identity_regexp_bundle, which binds the trailing @<ref> to the release tag ref refs/tags/knowledge-v<N> ONLY; a revocation (kill switch, dispatched from main) is verified against cert_identity_regexp_revocation, which binds @refs/heads/main ONLY. Separating these prevents an old reviewed commit from being retagged as a higher knowledge version and prevents a bundle from being signed off main. A bundle can never declare its own trust ('mode: bootstrap' is valid only for the immutable in-package snapshot). Root-of-trust: changes require two-party review (see core/promotion-policy.md).
